title: Propagation-Window Bounds in Degenerate Plant-Consumer Reaction-Diffusion Systems
summary: We study traveling waves in high-dimensional plant--consumer reaction--diffusion systems with $N$ competing plants and $N$ associated consumers. We focus on the degenerate case in which consumer growth vanishes when plant populations are zero, so the standard Fisher--KPP linearization does not determine the leading-edge behavior.
